text_block_list.text:
Just as the summer training camp with Ikuno Dictus
was about to get underway—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Ines Fujin is resting for the entire summer, huh...
She did look pretty worn out after the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: It just really makes you think about last year's Derby Umamusume, you know... I hope Ines can make a quick return to racing.
Among the public, many voices of concern were raised for Ines Fujin, who had recently announced her temporary break...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This is something I heard
from my roommate, McQueen-san, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since Ines-san announced her break,
Ryan-san seems to have been training with demonic intensity.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I want to follow Ryan-san's example, make the most of this training camp, and prepare for autumn.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Moments like these are precisely when management skills can be utilized to the fullest, after all."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Heading toward the Shuka Sho...
I need to fire myself up."

Ikuno Dictus recovered from her fatigue from the Oaks,
heading into the summer training camp
in top condition.

Just as she said, I want to make the most of this summer training camp for the autumn season.
That's my plan, but...

Ever since the Japan Derby, Ikuno Dictus'
spirit seemed to have shifted a little.

It's hard to put into words, but unlike before,
it felt as though a stronger resolve of some sort
had been added...
For now, it doesn't seem to have had a negative impact on their motivation, so I'm keeping an eye on things, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
I can see the training camp lodge now.

—Summer is coming.
A summer leading into their respective autumns.
